retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a central figure in a leisure suit seated in a wicker chair against a split-horizon cityscape and sunset, integrated with ethereal smoke-trail portraiture.
triggerTerms: wicker chair portrait with city skyline

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered airbrushed composition featuring a man in a yellow suit lounging in a white wicker chair. The background is divided into a starry night city skyline at the bottom and a warm orange sunset at the top, with a large white sun disk. A stylized smoke trail rises from a cigarette, forming both a woman's face and the main display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in yellow suit anchored to the right foreground
Smoke trail connecting the cigarette to the upper-left portrait and central text
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the composition into day and night zones
City skyline providing a dark, geometric base for the organic central figures
coreInvariants: The smoke trail must physically transition into the letterforms and the secondary portrait.
The color palette must maintain a high-contrast split between the yellow suit and the dark blue/black night sky.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is seated right-of-center, occupying approximately 50% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow suit acts as the primary focal point against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the smoke trail up to the portrait, across the lettering, and down to the city skyline.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black border framing the rounded-corner central illustration.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and midnight blue for the night sky and outer frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant lemon yellow for the subject's suit and city window highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and peach for the sunset gradient and smoke highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright subject/sun and the dark environment.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are formed from fluid, ribbon-like smoke trails
Variable stroke width with bulbous terminals
High-contrast white fill with soft airbrushed drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'L' have elongated, swirling swashes that merge into the background smoke.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom lettering style for all primary text to maintain the smoke-illusion theme.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn nature of 70s music art.
Matches the organic, whiplash curves of the smoke trails.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration of a man in a yellow 70s suit sitting in a white wicker chair. The background is a split horizon: a dark city skyline under a starry night sky on the bottom, and a warm orange sunset with a large white sun on top. A woman's face is faintly visible in a smoke cloud on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in a white psychedelic bubble style that appears to be formed by the smoke rising from the man's cigarette, following a slight upward curve.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it is made of smoke?
Is the suit a vibrant, high-contrast yellow?
Is the composition framed within a rounded-corner square?
Is the horizon line clearly defined between the city and the sunset?

adjustableVariables: Density of the city skyline buildings
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any existing brand logos or record label marks

mustAchieve: Fluid integration of text and imagery

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the smoke trail connects logically from the cigarette to the text.
Verify the yellow suit is the brightest element in the frame.
Check that the rounded frame border is consistent.
Confirm the city windows have a glowing yellow effect.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Central Figure in Leisure Suit] + [Wicker Chair] + [Split Horizon City/Sunset] + [Smoke-Trail Typography] to recreate the 70s soul aesthetic.
